subject.title: fix: resolve response prefix template variables in abort replies

question: Should maintainers repair this stale external branch in place, replace it narrowly, or keep waiting on the contributor before merge?
rationale: The remaining fix crosses active model/session state and routed delivery while the branch is conflicting, so a maintainer should choose the ownership path before more automation or merge work.

options.title: Require focused repair before merge
options.body: Update or replace the branch so routed abort delivery receives responsePrefix context and abort prefix values come from active model state rather than only config defaults.

options.title: Keep waiting on contributor
options.body: Leave the PR open in waiting-on-author state until the contributor rebases and addresses the existing review findings.

options.title: Close only after replacement exists
options.body: If maintainers prefer not to revive the branch, open a narrow replacement first so the linked bug does not lose its active fix path.

recommendation.title: Require focused repair before merge
recommendation.body: Update or replace the branch so routed abort delivery receives responsePrefix context and abort prefix values come from active model state rather than only config defaults.

likelyOwner.reason: The central helper and abort-dispatch seams point to this owner as the best available router for the merge-risk choice.
